name: Quantum Computing Inc.
verdict: FLAT, SHORT BARRED — 3 NOVEL kills (organic revenue ~$204K on a quantum multiple = category error; acquired anchor NHanced revenue halved into the close on a deferred Navy award; treasury->goodwill conversion $197M in 6mo w/ $72M unvalued contingent = war-chest-not-floor). NO price gate BY DESIGN: the only floor candidates are a squeeze-print tape and cash management demonstrably spends.
conviction: red 8/10 (2 FATALs reduced/overturned), blue 7/10 (re-based FLAT credited), adjudicated court-worthiness 4/10
kill_class_census: 3 NOVEL / 2 CONSENSUS after audit; short barred (meme/attention cohort, CROWDED, cohort beta days +-9-11%)

key_numbers.tape_note: 8/21 was a +9.6% cohort-squeeze print (IONQ +8.0, RGTI +11.5, QBTS +8.5) - not an anchor
key_numbers.incremental_gross_margin: -23.9% (level real; extrapolation overturned - provisional PPA in COGS)
key_numbers.insider: CEO exercised 584,897 warrants @ 8.95 for ~$5.2M cash 8/20 (code A - acquisition)

recourt_gates: BOTH at any price: (i) NHanced revenue re-acceleration verified in the 10-Q decomposition (Navy award restored/replaced), (ii) treasury flat-to-up ex-AFS-mark
OR: balance-sheet dispersion test run and QUBT >15pp cheaper than cohort on net-cash/mcap (the test all three artifacts left unrun)

narratives: PASS-RISK (multiple-expansion class, tripwire-less): cohort re-rates on an IONQ-class event, QUBT doubles on beta, no fundamental gate fires - miss accepted by design (not our pond)
PPA completion books $73.5M intangibles out of goodwill - optics improve; gates survive (they watch revenue+treasury) but never quote the goodwill number without the PPA caveat
REFLEXIVE: desk attention-cohort priors could blind us to a real pivot - CEO paid $5.2M cash at the tape; two more insider-add windows = look again regardless of gates
premortem.sentence: If this ruling costs us, the most likely reason will be a sector-wide quantum re-rate that no fundamental gate we set would ever catch - a miss we accept by design.
